rollups.text: Plant-based cooking and ingredients: On 2023-05-20, the user experimented with vegan recipes, especially lasagna, mushroom-based bolognese, oat-milk béchamel, tofu-and-spinach quiche, and plant milks and yogurts; they used Earth Balance and wanted to try other vegan butters. On 2023-05-25, they made chana masala, planned cashew paneer for vegan palak paneer, chose lentil curry and vegan quinoa bowls for meal prep, and considered stuffed peppers and vegan soups. They had successfully used cashew paneer before and considered repurposing leftover chana masala.

Italian food interests: After a recent trip to Tuscany and Umbria, discussed on 2023-05-23, the user explored paccheri alla vodka and spaghetti Bolognese, sought authentic olive oil and prosciutto, and wanted to try tiramisu, panna cotta, and hazelnut and pistachio gelato. The user enjoys gelato in a cone, especially on hot summer days, has tried gelato sandwiches, and is happy with any gelato.

Board games and game nights: On 2023-05-20, the user hosted friends for Ticket to Ride and enjoyed it. The user played Dixit with family during the holidays and enjoyed it, and has played Codenames and thought it was a blast. In May 2023, the user considered hosting another game night and trying Pandemic, and expressed interest in cooperative and strategy games, including Mysterium, Deception: Murder in Hong Kong, Terraforming Mars, 7 Wonders, Scythe, and Azul. The user likes Azul’s art and design and considered it for family game night; their sister is not a big fan of strategy games.

Gardening and growing food: By 2023-05-23, the user had eaten their first homegrown lettuce and expected a green-bean harvest; they sought recipes and storage advice. After a gardening workshop the previous weekend, they planned to make compost or fertilizer from kitchen scraps and eggshells, and asked about adding banana peels and saved coffee grounds. They also considered marigolds and other companion plants for tomatoes to help control nematodes. On 2023-05-27, they considered low-maintenance bedroom plants, a small kitchen herb garden and suitable pots, and planting backyard trees to provide koala habitat.

Fishing: In April 2023, the user went on a guided pike-fishing trip in Canada with their father; guide Mike taught them a hook-setting technique, and the user caught several large pike. The user later practiced that technique and said it improved their catch rate. During the weekend of 2023-05-20 to 2023-05-21, the user fished Lake Michigan with buddy Alex, catching 12 trout using spinners and PowerBait, including a 3-pound trout. The user planned to restock hooks and sinkers, organize their tackle box, and try pike fishing again.

Honda Civic Si track driving and upgrades: The user owns or drives a Honda Civic Si, specified as a 2018 model in May 2023. They attended a high-performance driving education event and tracked lap times, aiming to improve their performance. They considered KW Variant 3 coilovers, adjustable sway bars, track wheels and tires, and brake pads and rotors. On 2023-05-26, they also described attending the Turbocharged event at the LA County Fairgrounds, considered a track suspension budget of about $2,000, and planned to ask Alex for a recommended mechanic’s contact information and discuss alignment shops.

Home lighting and plants: Around 2023-04-30, the user replaced a bedroom ceiling fixture with adjustable arms and LED bulbs. By 2023-05-21, they had tried Philips Hue lighting in the living room and replaced living-room lampshades with IKEA shades, which they said made the room cozier. They wanted satin-nickel recessed kitchen lighting to match hardware and planned to check LED bulb CRI and dimming. On 2023-05-27, they considered low-maintenance indoor plants and a small kitchen herb garden.

Board-game snacks and hosting: On 2023-05-23, while considering another home game night, the user liked the suggested Railway Rails snack—licorice ropes dipped in chocolate—and asked about chocolate and nuts. Suggested variations included milk chocolate with almonds and coconut, dark chocolate with pecans and sea salt, and white chocolate with hazelnuts and dried cranberries. The user had hosted a Ticket to Ride game night on 2023-05-20 and was considering hosting again.

Fresh Earth Ecosystem implementation planning: On 2023-05-20, the user planned to develop an implementation plan, beginning with the first components to launch and providing the technology vision before details about individual components. The Project Management Platform was intended to connect global stakeholders in regenerative health and land projects and support program design, implementation and commercialization through project management, data analysis, a B2B marketplace, validation systems and group tools. No later implementation-plan progress is recorded here.

Home barbecue planning: During the weekend of 2023-05-20 to 2023-05-21, the user helped a neighbor host a barbecue and cook for about 20 people. On 2023-05-25, they chose a spicy pineapple barbecue sauce recipe, planned to make and store a large batch, and intended to use it at their next backyard barbecue. They also had a family gathering coming up, expected to grill many chicken breasts, and planned to serve them with coleslaw and baked beans; they asked how to cook chicken evenly and keep it juicy and warm for serving.

Home gaming and computer equipment: The user installed a graphics card bought in December 2022 and reported a substantially better gaming experience on 2023-05-29. On 2023-05-26, they considered upgrading to an RTX 3080 Ti and asked about the difference from an RTX 3080; they also considered a gaming keyboard with customizable lighting and macros, and compared Cherry MX Brown and Speed switches with the Romer-G switches in their Logitech G512. On 2023-05-29, they considered another GPU, a general-use monitor, and a Logitech M720 Triathlon to replace a mouse with intermittent connectivity and short battery life. No purchase of the considered items is recorded.

Spirituality, faith and volunteering: On 2023-05-30, the user said they had recently attended religious services and events and were exploring spirituality and mindfulness. They were interested in The Power of Now and Mindfulness in Plain English, planned to check guided meditation recordings by Bhante Henepola Gunaratana, and had recently volunteered at a soup kitchen and enjoyed it. The user also discussed Psalms in a Bible study group and recalled sermons at St. Mary’s Church about forgiveness and “beggarly prayers.”

Unity PVD instructional simulation: On 2023-05-30, the user described a Unity virtual-reality simulation teaching physical vapor deposition (PVD), including PPE and tool overviews, the PVD process, an atomic-scale section and a conclusion, with effects, haptics and virtual instructor Simon. The user requested asset lists and then a combined CSV-style inventory of 3D and sound assets. The resulting inventory covered cleanroom and PPE models, the PVD tool and process, wafer and atom visuals, additional resources and a quiz, plus associated sound effects and voiceover.

Fishing catch counts: During the weekend of 2023-05-20 to 2023-05-21, the user and Alex caught 12 trout at Lake Michigan; one was reported as weighing 3 pounds. In April 2023, the user caught several large pike on a guided trip in Canada with their father; no exact count was given.

Chocolate-craving plans: On 2023-05-24, the user said they wanted to cut back on chocolate because they consumed enough to want to reduce it and found cravings hard to resist. They said stress or anxiety tended to increase the cravings and planned to drink more water and snack on fruit. These records describe one stated plan; no later outcome is recorded.
